description.zh: 批量重命名：按规则或文本方式预览并改名选中的项目；选中一个文件夹改的是这个文件夹本身。文件夹里的项目用“在此文件夹批量重命名”打开。单文件改名请用 Win顺 的 F2。
description.en: Batch rename the selected items with rules or a text buffer; a selected folder is renamed itself. For a folder's contents, use Batch rename in this folder. Use WinShun F2 for a single file.
